name: Competição Curtas Portuguesas 2
description: This event presents a selection of Portuguese short films as part of Queer Porto 12. The session includes five short films and a Q&A with some of the directors and participants.
longDescription:
The "Competição Curtas Portuguesas 2" event features five Portuguese short films: "Unruhe" by Carlos Pereira, "O Meu Amor do Rancho" by Miguel De, "Abril de Helena" by Maria Moreira and Victor Hugooli, "A Vaqueira, a Dançarina e o Porco" by Stella Carneiro and Ary Zara, and "Éramos Só Putos" by João Nunes Monteiro.

The session is scheduled for November 6, 2026, at 17:00, at Batalha Centro de Cinema. Tickets cost €5. Following the film screenings, Miguel De (director of "O Meu Amor do Rancho") and Maria Moreira, Victor Hugooli, Abril Xavier, and Helena Costa (from "Abril de Helena") will be present for a Q&A session.
